updates.briefDescription: To meet the high cooling demands of this and the upcoming circuits, a new engine cover aiming at increased cooling massflow has been designed.
updates.sourceText: Coke/Engine Cover | Circuit specific - Cooling Range | High Cooling Bodywork | To meet the high cooling demands of this and the upcoming circuits, a new engine cover aiming at increased cooling massflow has been designed.
updates.description: To meet the high cooling demands of this and the upcoming circuits, a new engine cover aiming at increased cooling massflow has been designed.

updates.geometricDifference: Reprofiled horizontal elements, and vertical slotted upper element added.
updates.briefDescription: Reprofiled elements and new vertical elements added to improve local pressure distribution, reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, and improve flow to the rear of the car, resulting in increased load.
updates.sourceText: Floor Board | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled horizontal elements, and vertical slotted upper element added. | Reprofiled elements and new vertical elements added to improve local pressure distribution, reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, and improve flow to the rear of the car, resulting in increased load.
updates.description: Reprofiled elements and new vertical elements added to improve local pressure distribution, reduce separations at the extremes of the operating envelope, and improve flow to the rear of the car, resulting in increased load.

updates.geometricDifference: Reprofiled and additional down-washing elements added.
updates.briefDescription: Additional down-washing elements increase local load and outwash, improving flow to the rear of the car and increasing rear floor load.
updates.sourceText: Floor Leading Edge | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Reprofiled and additional down-washing elements added. | Additional down-washing elements increase local load and outwash, improving flow to the rear of the car and increasing rear floor load.
updates.description: Additional down-washing elements increase local load and outwash, improving flow to the rear of the car and increasing rear floor load.

updates.briefDescription: Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load.
updates.sourceText: Floor Corner | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Additional slots and reprofiled elements. | Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load.
updates.description: Re-optimisation of floor corner slot arrangement to both increase local load and to also improve flow into the diffuser and hence rear load.

updates.geometricDifference: Reprofiled diffuser roof, sidewall, and winglet.
updates.briefDescription: Through re-optimisation of the diffuser roof and sidewall we have increased local load and improved robustness throughout the operating envelope.
updates.sourceText: Floor Body | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled diffuser roof, sidewall, and winglet. | Through re-optimisation of the diffuser roof and sidewall we have increased local load and improved robustness throughout the operating envelope.
updates.description: Through re-optimisation of the diffuser roof and sidewall we have increased local load and improved robustness throughout the operating envelope.

updates.briefDescription: Track rod and driveshaft camber re-distributed to increase local load whilst improving coupling with diffuser winglet and rear drum furniture.
updates.sourceText: Rear Suspension | Performance – Local Load | Reprofiled suspension fairings. | Track rod and driveshaft camber re-distributed to increase local load whilst improving coupling with diffuser winglet and rear drum furniture.
updates.description: Track rod and driveshaft camber re-distributed to increase local load whilst improving coupling with diffuser winglet and rear drum furniture.

updates.geometricDifference: Rear winglet span and position change.
updates.briefDescription: Chord and position of the rear drum winglets re- optimised to work with above fairing update and to improve rear tyre wake control across the operating envelope.
updates.sourceText: Rear Corner | Performance – Local Load | Rear winglet span and position change. | Chord and position of the rear drum winglets re- optimised to work with above fairing update and to improve rear tyre wake control across the operating envelope.
updates.description: Chord and position of the rear drum winglets re- optimised to work with above fairing update and to improve rear tyre wake control across the operating envelope.

updates.briefDescription: Reduce volume and increased sideview ramp increases downwash to the rear floor and rear drum, resulting in more load.
updates.sourceText: Rear Bodywork | Performance - Flow Conditioning | Reduce volume, increased sideview ramp. | Reduce volume and increased sideview ramp increases downwash to the rear floor and rear drum, resulting in more load.
updates.description: Reduce volume and increased sideview ramp increases downwash to the rear floor and rear drum, resulting in more load.

updates.briefDescription: Applied above the existing floor foot geometry, the new board realises development work to extract more load locally whilst maintaining flow stability behind the front tyres.
updates.sourceText: Floor Board | Performance - Local Load | Revised Floor Board geometry | Applied above the existing floor foot geometry, the new board realises development work to extract more load locally whilst maintaining flow stability behind the front tyres.
updates.description: Applied above the existing floor foot geometry, the new board realises development work to extract more load locally whilst maintaining flow stability behind the front tyres.

updates.geometricDifference: Diffuser outboard winglet cascade element development
updates.briefDescription: Not Sepang track specific, this very localized development around the diffuser winglet cascade is providing a favourable additional downforce across the entire car operating envelope
updates.sourceText: Diffuser | Performance - Local Load | Diffuser outboard winglet cascade element development | Not Sepang track specific, this very localized development around the diffuser winglet cascade is providing a favourable additional downforce across the entire car operating envelope
updates.description: Not Sepang track specific, this very localized development around the diffuser winglet cascade is providing a favourable additional downforce across the entire car operating envelope

updates.briefDescription: A longer chord flap for the front wing that was introduced at the previous event increases the load that can be generated by the wing, meeting the aero balance requirements for this circuit.
updates.sourceText: Front Wing | Circuit specific - Balance Range | New front flap | A longer chord flap for the front wing that was introduced at the previous event increases the load that can be generated by the wing, meeting the aero balance requirements for this circuit.
updates.description: A longer chord flap for the front wing that was introduced at the previous event increases the load that can be generated by the wing, meeting the aero balance requirements for this circuit.

updates.briefDescription: An improved design of the rear wing support components allows the rear wing to perform more effectively, increasing the efficiency of load generated.
updates.sourceText: Rear Wing | Performance - Local Load | Revised rear wing auxiliary components | An improved design of the rear wing support components allows the rear wing to perform more effectively, increasing the efficiency of load generated.
updates.description: An improved design of the rear wing support components allows the rear wing to perform more effectively, increasing the efficiency of load generated.

updates.briefDescription: An additional Rear Impact Structure device will be available on track, enabling targeted tuning of the car’s characteristics for this circuit.
updates.sourceText: Rear Impact Structure | Performance – Local Load | Updated Rear Impact Structure geometry | An additional Rear Impact Structure device will be available on track, enabling targeted tuning of the car’s characteristics for this circuit.
updates.description: An additional Rear Impact Structure device will be available on track, enabling targeted tuning of the car’s characteristics for this circuit.

updates.briefDescription: The front drum exit has been trimmed to increase brake cooling capacity, improving thermal management for the upcoming high-demand tracks.
updates.sourceText: Front Corner | Performance – Brake Cooling | Revised front drum exit | The front drum exit has been trimmed to increase brake cooling capacity, improving thermal management for the upcoming high-demand tracks.
updates.description: The front drum exit has been trimmed to increase brake cooling capacity, improving thermal management for the upcoming high-demand tracks.
